description.narrative: The project is implemented in Serbia. The main outcome areas it contributes to are democracy and human rights, equality and worker's rights. The main rights holders are Roma, internally displaced persons, refugees, women from rural areas and persons living in poverty. Through challenging a dominant political narrative, fighting discrimination of the most vulnerable communities and confronting criminalisation of poverty the project aims to achieve progressive development within the outcome areas.Project OrganisationsThe project is cooperation between A11 Initiative for Economic and Social Rights and the National Secretariat of the Workers Educational Association (ABF-frbundet). A11 is a Serbian non-governmental organisation focused on socio economic rights from various perspectives including advocacy, education and outreach. ABF is Sweden's largest association for popular education and is present in all municipalities. The National Secretariat supports the growth of operations within the ABF organisation.Project ObjectiveThe aim of this cooperation is to contribute to the protection of economic and social rights (ESRs) through enhanced participation of the most marginalised communities in the decision-making process relevant for the enjoyment of economic and social rights. Furthermore, this aim is divided into five different objectives: 1. Increased understanding of key concepts of ESRs among different stakeholders and the improvement of the ESRs oriented cooperation with other progressive movements, political parties, CSOs, academic institutions, media and trade unions, 2. Enhanced participation of marginalised population in decision making processes through community-led monitoring of ESRs and their enhanced engagement with the mechanisms for the protections of these rights, 3. Improved cooperation of local and regional initiatives aiming to protect ESRs and to challenge dominant State policies towards ESRs, 4. Establishment of the national economic and social rights movement with an aim to influence legislative and policy-making processes relevant for the realization of ESRs and to positively influence decision-makers at the local, national and regional level, 5. Increased number of cases of strategic litigation for the improvement of the protection of ESRs.Actor groupsActor groups are very broad since the project will implement activities pertaining advocacy and alliance building. --Decision-makers-- Judiciary Parliament Governments at all levels --Actors in Cooperation-- Trade unions Academia Media Progressive movements, activists etc. --Right-holders-- Roma, internally displaced persons, refugees, women from rural areas and persons living in poverty
